works.body: Hello, thank you for your appeal. My character is a nekomimi female with rose pink hair and light teal eyes. Feel free to draw her any way you like.

Hello, Mr. Ryomori.
I am Jasuma, the person who greeted you.

Thank you for liking my self-created character, Haofi!

I have seen your past pictures, Ryoumori-sama. I found your illustrations of the Star Rail character, the ghost child, and the girl with the eye patch very cute and attractive in their patterns, so I would like to make a request for them!

As you suggested in your message, I would like to leave the costume design to Mr. Ryoumori this time..!

The material of Haofi is here.
https://note.com/psyan75_17_ra/n/n2199d76dc144

■Character Introduction
Haofi is a former human zombie and necromancer.
He chose to become immortal by his own self-discipline in order to be close to the ghost of his best friend, who was no longer able to go to heaven or hell.
Since he became a zombie by his own will, his heart is still alive and spiritual energy is circulating in his body instead of blood. This is why he is so hot-blooded that it is hard to believe that he is a zombie.

He uses frying pans and ladles heated with Hitodama, which are always floating around him, as weapons and has a fighting style that combines Hakkyoken (sometimes Drunken Fist) and also uses the sacred talismans on his thighs to control Kyongshi.

His favorite food is fried rice, which he punishingly stir-fries with a stranger's human head, but otherwise he is a hot-blooded but sensible person.

■Exterior Characteristics
He has white hair in a bun, with seven colors of light reflecting in his hair. In the current design, he has two aphids.

She has expressive type of jitters, and her eyes are golden by default, but they turn into odd eyes when the tension is high. There is pink makeup on the corner of her eyes.

She has blue skin with stitches on her cheeks, left arm and right leg. Her right leg is a little darker.

Based on the above character description, I would be happy if you could draw Haofi in the new outfit that Ryoumori-sama has in mind!

If there are no flaws in your request, please let us know!

Thank you for your appeal, please go ahead and draw Matcha. I would be interested to see you draw her!
